summary: The requirement document asks for one system for a honey co-operative's members, 12 collection centres and head office. It covers member registration, apiary records, honey intake with QR labels and offline tablets, quality testing and traceability, member payments, an online shop, three languages and reports, with two years of support.

evidence.quote: Beekeepers shall register as members online with their village, bank details and the number of hives they keep.

stories: As a beekeeper, I can register as a member online with my village, bank details and number of hives

evidence.quote: Head office shall see all apiaries on a map.

stories: As a head office manager, I can see all apiaries on a map

evidence.quote: Centre staff shall scan the drum QR codes with the tablet camera when drums leave for the processing plant.

stories: As centre staff, I can scan drum QR codes with the tablet camera when drums leave for the processing plant

evidence.quote: Collection centres often lose internet; entries shall be saved on the tablet and sent when the connection returns.

stories: As centre staff, I can save entries on the tablet and have them sent when the connection returns

evidence.quote: Members shall get an SMS when their honey is weighed and when payment is sent.

stories: As a member, I get an SMS when my honey is weighed
As a member, I get an SMS when payment is sent

evidence.quote: Screens shall be available in Marathi, Kannada and English.

stories: As a user, I can use the screens in Marathi, Kannada or English

evidence.quote: The co-operative shall sell bottled honey to the public in an online shop with a cart and online payment.

stories: As a customer, I can buy bottled honey in the online shop with a cart and online payment

evidence.quote: Managers shall see reports of honey collected by centre, by month and by grade, and payments made.

stories: As a manager, I can see reports of honey collected by centre, by month and by grade, and payments made

other_features.name: Apiary and hive records
other_features.description: Members keep a record of each apiary: its location, hives, queen replacement dates and inspection notes.
stories: As a member, I can keep a record of each apiary with its location, hives, queen replacement dates and inspection notes

evidence.quote: Members shall keep a record of each apiary: its location, hives, queen replacement dates and inspection notes.

other_features.name: Honey intake, grading and labels
other_features.description: Centre staff weigh honey, record moisture and grade, and print a QR label for each drum.
stories: As centre staff, I can weigh each member's honey and record moisture and grade
As centre staff, I can print a label with a QR code for each drum

evidence.quote: At the collection centre, staff shall weigh each member's honey, record moisture and grade, and print a label with a QR code for each drum.

other_features.name: Batch quality testing and traceability
other_features.description: Testers record lab results for each batch and every jar is traceable to its drums and members.
stories: As a quality tester, I can record lab results for each batch
As a manager, I can trace every jar back to the drums and members it came from

evidence.quote: Quality testers shall record lab results for each batch, and every jar shall be traceable back to the drums and members it came from.

other_features.name: Member payment calculation and bulk payout
other_features.description: Work out each member's payment from weight and grade and send payments to bank accounts in bulk.
stories: As the accounts team, I can work out each member's payment from the weight and grade
As the accounts team, I can send payments to members' bank accounts in bulk

evidence.quote: The accounts team shall work out each member's payment from the weight and grade, and send payments to members' bank accounts in bulk.
Centre staff use the system in a browser on tablets; a separate mobile app is not required.
Madhu Sahakari is a co-operative of about 2,500 beekeepers in the Western Ghats of Maharashtra and Karnataka.
The vendor shall support the system for two years after go-live.
Screens shall be available in Marathi, Kannada and English.
